items.list.statement: SELECT i.id, i.name, i.stock - coalesce((SELECT sum(o.qty) FROM orders o WHERE o.item_id = i.id AND (o.status = 'paid' OR o.created_at > ?1 - i.hold_ms)), 0) AS available FROM items i ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 50

orders.hold.guard: Not enough left, or the quantity is not 1 to 5.
orders.hold.statement: INSERT INTO orders (item_id, user_id, qty, created_at) SELECT i.id, ?2, ?3, ?4 FROM items i WHERE i.id = ?1 AND ?3 BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND i.stock - coalesce((SELECT sum(o.qty) FROM orders o WHERE o.item_id = i.id AND (o.status = 'paid' OR o.created_at > ?4 - i.hold_ms)), 0) >= ?3

orders.mine.statement: SELECT id, item_id, qty, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

payments.confirm.guard: That hold is gone or already paid.
payments.confirm.statement: UPDATE orders SET status = 'paid' WHERE id = ?1 AND status = 'held' AND created_at > ?2 - (SELECT hold_ms FROM items WHERE items.id = orders.item_id)
